title: Minibadge chain
author: Pips
description: A board that can be chained together to create a minibadge display.
specialInstructions: Power this board with my Minibadge Devboard! or your own 3v3/5v power supply.
solderingInstructions: Measure lengths of wire, solder them end to end on the badge. Solder pin sockets.

title: ESP32 Meshtastic Minibadge
author: Pips
description: A minibadge that will hold a XIAO ESP32 - specifically made for the WIO Meshtastic module.
specialInstructions: Comes pre-flashed with meshtastic firmware. Can be easily updated to the latest firmware through the meshtastic flasher website.
solderingInstructions:
Solder on ESP module.
Solder 5V jumper (do not solder 3v)
solder on diodes
solder pin headers

title: IPEX to SMA adapter Minibadge
author: Pips
description: A minibadge (meant for use with my Meshtastic Minibadge) that converts I-PEX to SMA, so you can have a vertical SMA antenna.
solderingInstructions: Solder pin headers and plug in your IPEX to IPEX cable, and screw in your SMA antenna!
howToAcquire: Find me during the conference, or buy one from my Tindie store.

title: Charger Minibadge
author: Pips
description: Have you ever needed to charge your phone (or other stuff), but all you have lying around is a SAINTCON badge? You’re in luck! This minibadge will charge (up to 500mA) anything USB-C that you plug into it! Charge your phone! Charge your headphones! Charge a laptop! (not really) Charge another badge! The world is your charger!
solderingInstructions: Solder pin headers and start charging!
howToAcquire: Trade with me or buy one from my Tindie store!

title: Perfboard prototyping minibadge
author: Pips
description: A perfboard minibadge for rapid prototyping at the conference! Design your own minibadge without the need for EDA software, just solder LEDs and let it rip!

title: Minibadge Display Devboard
author: Pips
description: This board provides everything your custom Minibadge display will need, including LiPo battery charging/use and USB-C power. It can be attached board-to-board with your own PCB designs, or it can be wired up using push-in WAGO wire terminals to your existing displays.
specialInstructions:
- Input (USB-C): 5V@3A
- Input (Battery): 4.2V@3A
- Battery charging: 4.2V@800mA
- Output (3.3V): 3.3V@3A
- Output (CLK): 3.3V@3A
- Output (SYS): Input voltage@amperage (whichever is higher)
- Max total minibadges: 30-50
howToAcquire: Purchase from my Tindie store - https://www.tindie.com/stores/pips/
